question: Does the .iloc[0] exemplar bug explain ACCORD AUROC 0.460, or is the no-signal finding independent of it?
method: Rules 3 (dosage) and 4 (omission) never had the exemplar-selection bug -- their evidence is the dose difference or the absence itself, not a selected mention. Restricting the gold evaluation to those strata gives a defect-free measurement.
conclusion: On the defect-free strata AUROC is 0.5078 with Mann-Whitney p=0.953 -- exactly chance. The no-signal finding is INDEPENDENT of the exemplar bug. Label noise was not attenuating a real signal.
caveat: Only 6 positives in the defect-free strata, so the CI is wide; the point estimate sits at chance rather than above it, and the per-rule estimates (rule 2 n=31, rule 4 n=55) are individually unreliable.
